check: V2 chase-strike sword vs conservative card-label rectangles
method: PIL raster sweep of sword polygon and stroked guard/handle at 3x SVG resolution. 1001 uniformly spaced beat progress samples p=0..1. Both sword and card share scene camera transform, so check performed in shared local coordinates. Conservative card label rectangles include padding around uppercase text.
scope: label occlusion only; does not certify whole scene visual quality
